obligationFindings.KNOWN_PREFILLS: FAIL, on the boundary fixtures, and this is the consequence of the CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP repair rather than a separate accident. THE MEASUREMENT. The canonical assemblies write 13 (pre) and 9 (post) values and refuse none. The boundary assemblies write 8 and 4 and refuse TEN - five per boundary posture - and every refusal is a fact the platform holds and the field map binds: matter.case_number on both the petition and the proposed order, and participant.full_legal_name in the WHEREFORE prayer, in the FURTHER prayer and in the proposed order's operative 'Defendant, ____, to Dismiss' clause. Measured on the delivered pixels at 150 dpi, grey<128, whole page, annotations drawn, against each pinned source page: on pre-adjudication-boundary packet page 4 (petition page 3, the prayer page) added ink is 166 px against 1,298 px on the same page of the canonical, because only the date of birth survives; on packet page 8 (order page 3) added ink is 0 px against 474 px on the canonical, so the clause naming the person the court is asked to dismiss carries NO INK AT ALL. post-adjudication-boundary is the same shape: page 4 176 px against 1,258, page 8 0 px against 488. The case number is absent from the caption of both instruments in both boundary postures - packet pages 2 and 6 fall from two write rectangles to one. The canonical figures on those same pages, taken by the same detector at the same settings, are the positive control for every zero here. WHY THAT IS A DEFECT AND NOT AN ACCEPTABLE REFUSAL. The refusal itself is honest and well recorded: reports/rendered-artifacts.json carries all ten with the widget width, the 4 pt padding, the usable width, the required width at the 6 pt minimum, the overflow, notTruncated true, and a composed participant-facing sentence - 'This value does not fit the printed blank at the smallest readable size, so the packet leaves it blank rather than truncating it or drawing over the form. Write it on the printed line by hand, or ask the clerk how a value this long is recorded on this form.' NONE OF THAT REACHES ANY DELIVERED DOCUMENT. Measured: 'does not fit', 'by hand', 'too long', 'truncat' and 'smallest readable' occur 0 times in participant-instructions.md, and 0 times on any of the 36 delivered pages. The string 'Case No' occurs 0 times in participant-instructions.md, so the case number is not on the guide's list of blanks the participant must supply either. The delivered page therefore looks exactly like a blank official-form line and nothing anywhere tells the reader that a value was withheld or that they must write it in. AND THE PACKET HAS THE SURFACE TO SAY SO. Packet page 1 is not a static guide: it is generated per packet and it prints this participant's own values. On post-adjudication-boundary it reads 'Prepared for Alexandrina-Katharine Montgomery-Vandenberg-Oyelaran y Fitzwilliam III; case 0123-45-2026-CR-900123.00-AB-CDE/2201.' - the very case number that is blank on the petition caption one page later. The open question FIX159 left ('a statically generated guide arguably cannot carry it') does not arise: the mechanism exists, it is per-packet, it already prints the missing value, and it is silent about the refusal. WHAT WOULD SATISFY IT: the ten refusals, which the build already composes with a participant-facing sentence, printed onto the per-packet guidance page (or into the guide's blanks list) for the packet they belong to, so that a delivered document says which blanks were left for the participant's hand and why.
obligationFindings.REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING: FAIL, on a defect this lane found rather than on VF05's. VF05'S FAILURE IS CLOSED AND THIS LANE CONFIRMS IT INDEPENDENTLY: production-field-map.json carries 66 items with requiredBeforeFiling true, all 66 with disposition REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, and 66 of 66 are named in participant-instructions.md by an identifiedBy string present verbatim - counted here by whitespace-normalised exact substring against the delivered markdown. All FOUR Sex fields now carry effectiveLabel 'Sex'; the guide prints 4 rows named Sex and 4 named Race, so VF05's decisive instance (a Sex field labelled 'Race', two consecutive 'Race' rows, no 'Sex' row) is gone. Five effectiveLabel values are still degenerate underscore runs and 27 effectiveLabel values already carry the synthetic '<documentId> printed blank <name>' form, but effectiveLabel is not what the guide prints: 'printed blank' occurs 0 times in participant-instructions.md and 0 of the 66 identifiedBy strings contain it. WHAT FAILS IS THE MECHANISM THAT REPAIR INSTALLED. FIX49 made each row identify its blank by QUOTING the printed line it sits on. In EIGHT of the 66 rows the quoted line is not the line the page prints, in three distinct corruptions, each measured here against the delivered bytes: (1) FOUR rows quote '______________, _____, and charged with the oense(s) of' where the page prints 'offense(s)'. Cause confirmed by pdftotext -bbox on the delivered post-adjudication petition page: 'o' ends at x=413.558 and 'ense(s' begins at x=421.560, an 8.0 pt gap of unmapped ink where the ff ligature is, while the identical sentence in the sibling ORDER document in the same file extracts cleanly. So the PAGE is right and the extractor lost a ligature. (2) TWO rows quote 'A Class _____ [_] felony in violation of A.C.A.§[_] misdemeanor'. The delivered pre-adjudication petition page prints 'A Class _____ [_] felony [_] misdemeanor in violation of A.C.A.§' and THE SAME EXTRACTOR READS IT CORRECTLY. This one is not a ligature loss: the words are reordered, and it is a composition error in how the printed row was assembled, which is a class FIX159's diagnosis does not cover. (3) TWO rows quote 'in violationof A.C.A.§' where the page prints 'in violation of A.C.A.§'. The correct form of that Class line appears 0 times in the whole guide. On two of the eight rows (POST:Month and POST:Year) the misquoted line is the ONLY locator: a participant is told to find a blank by an ordinal on a sentence that is not printed anywhere on their form. Repairing (1) at cause is a shared-library change in text extraction that 309 builders depend on and is outside any lane's family grant; (2) and (3) are this family's own composition and are repairable without touching the shared reader - but a rebuild at HEAD also imports the 11 unrelated effectiveLabel changes that shared-library commit e258e47a0 introduced, which is the cost a repairing lane has to own.

obligationFindings.CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP: PASS, and reached by refusal rather than by fitting, which this lane confirms and accepts FOR THIS OBLIGATION. Measured on the flattened widget XObjects rather than on the build report: each /FlatWidget-* appearance stream was decoded in this lane, its drawn string and Tf size read, the actual clip window taken from the stream's own 'W n' path, and the string width computed from the face the page actually uses - the shared standard-14 AFM metrics, because these are base-14 Helvetica resources with NO /Widths array and a naive 500/1000 fallback reads Helvetica about 8-10 percent narrow. ON THE CURRENT BYTES: 0 of 34 text-carrying appearances exceed their clip window, at TOL 0 and at TOL -2. POSITIVE CONTROL, and it is the strongest kind available - the same detector run against the exact pre-repair fixtures VF05 measured, recovered from git at 26838a27b^ and hashed here to cc5470f4.. and 5ee9b46c..: it fires on exactly TEN overflowing appearances, five per boundary fixture, and names exactly the values VF05 named - the case number '0123-45-2026-CR-900123.00-AB-CDE/2201' overflowing by 2.29 and 14.20 pt and the petitioner's name by 33.38, 25.82, 18.02, 7.91, 42.94 and 37.00 pt. The appearance census confirms the shape of the change exactly: text-carrying appearances go 13 to 8 and 9 to 4 on the two boundary fixtures while the canonicals stay at 13 and 9, so precisely ten appearances lost their text and nothing was reflowed, resized or moved. (This lane counts 13 where FIX159 counts 15 on the pre-adjudication documents; the difference is definitional and was traced - 15 appearances carry a Tj operator, two of which draw an EMPTY string. The delta of five, and the identity of the ten, agree exactly.) REMOVAL DIRECTION: removed ink against the pinned sources is 0 px on all 32 measured pages of all four fixtures, so nothing the ACIC form prints has been erased. OVERLAP: 0 px of added ink falls outside a declared write rectangle on any page of any fixture, so VF05's corroborating collisions - 'Fitzwilliam' and 'III' printed over the words 'prays', 'to' and 'Dismiss' - are gone with the text that caused them. obligationFindings.FILING_DESTINATION: PASS. The delivered guidance page and participant-instructions.md both send the filing to the underlying criminal court after programme completion, which is the track record's own destination (kind court, name 'The underlying criminal court') and venue ('program-specific process in the underlying criminal court; local program and prosecutor concurrence requirements may apply'). obligationFindings.FEE_AND_WAIVER: PASS. The track record says 'The source review does not state a filing fee for this petition' and 'The source review does not address a fee waiver', and adds that it does not state a notarization requirement. The delivered guidance page carries all three as an attributed refusal - 'the committed route says the source review does not state a filing fee, fee-waiver procedure, or notarization requirement, while its review flags preserve conflicts on those points. Confirm those items with the filing court before signing or filing; this packet does not invent an answer' - and participant-instructions.md says the same. This is an honest refusal that names who to ask, which is the distinction that separates it from the fabricated-fee failures in this cohort.
obligationFindings.SERVICE: PASS. The track record's service rule is 'Serve the prosecuting attorney within three days of filing. The prosecuting attorney has 30 days to object.' and its notice rule records the same 30-day objection window. Both reach the participant: the delivered guidance page says 'serve the prosecuting attorney within three days after filing; the track records a 30-day objection window', and participant-instructions.md repeats it and adds 'Complete a certificate of service only after service occurred.' No method, no deadline and no proof-of-service requirement is asserted beyond what the record carries, and the guide correctly does not tell the participant a service method the record does not settle.
obligationFindings.SELF_HELP_STOP: PASS. The track record carries FIVE selfHelpStopConditions and all five reach the delivered documents in substance, checked one by one against the delivered bytes: prosecutor objection within the 30-day window and a contested hearing ('Stop self-help for any objection or contested hearing'); immigration, licensing or firearm consequences (named in the same sentence); programme not completed ('uncertainty about completion or posture'); and prosecutor concurrence at admission being negotiation rather than self-help ('prosecutor-concurrence negotiation', and on the guidance page 'The packet does not enroll anyone, negotiate concurrence, or decide whether completion occurred'). None is omitted. NOT VERBATIM: 0 of the 5 reach either document as an exact substring, and neither do the packet-set manifest's 8 requiredBeforeFiling record strings nor the record's 4 scopeRestrictions. That is this family's convention and it is the RIGHT one for the four scope restrictions, which are written to the people who build the service ('The broad conclusion that diversion and specialty-court tracks are all guidance-only is superseded...'); quoting those to a participant would be exactly the DEFECTS_NO_COUNTER_CAN_SEE instance VF22 failed Maine on. Noted so no later lane reads the verbatim zero as a miss: substance is complete, and the two families in this return sit at opposite ends of the same question.

theARKANSASBLANKFIELDSQUESTION.theQuestion: FIX159 states the clipping zero was reached by refusal, not by fitting: exactly the ten overflowing writes lost their text, so the case number and petitioner name are blank on the boundary pages. Is that a correct CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP pass, or did it trade an overflow defect for a missing-content defect another obligation should catch?
theARKANSASBLANKFIELDSQUESTION.thisLanesAnswer: BOTH, and they are not in tension. CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP PASSES, correctly. AND the repair traded an overflow defect for a missing-content defect, which KNOWN_PREFILLS catches and on which this family FAILS.
theARKANSASBLANKFIELDSQUESTION.whyTheCLIPPINGPassIsCorrect: The obligation asks whether anything on the delivered page is clipped, truncated, or drawn over the form. On these bytes nothing is: 0 of 34 text-carrying appearances exceed their own clip window, 0 px of added ink falls outside a declared write rectangle, and 0 px of the form's printed ink has been removed on any of 32 pages. Refusal is a legitimate way to reach that zero, and the specific danger of reaching a clipping zero dishonestly - shrinking a value until it fits and calling that a repair, or truncating the string while leaving the text layer whole so a text-only check still reads it - is exactly what did NOT happen: no appearance was resized, reflowed or moved, the text layer no longer carries the value either, and the build records notTruncated true against each refusal with the usable width it was measured against. VF05's defect was a silently truncated case number on the rendered page under a whole string in the text layer. That defect is gone and it did not come back in another form. This lane's positive control - the same detector firing on exactly ten overflows against the exact pre-repair bytes VF05 read - is what makes the zero worth anything.
theARKANSASBLANKFIELDSQUESTION.whyItIsAlsoAMissingContentDefect: A refusal is honest only if the person holding the paper learns of it. Ten held facts were withheld from the delivered pages and NOTHING DELIVERED SAYS SO. The build composes a participant-facing sentence for each refusal and files it in reports/rendered-artifacts.json and reports/actual-writes.json, which are internal review artifacts. On the delivered documents the phrases 'does not fit', 'by hand', 'too long', 'truncat' and 'smallest readable' occur 0 times, and 'Case No' occurs 0 times in participant-instructions.md. What the participant receives is a petition and a proposed order whose caption case number is blank and whose operative clause names nobody, indistinguishable from an unfilled official form.
theARKANSASBLANKFIELDSQUESTION.whyTheRuntimeExcuseDoesNotHold: FIX159 left open whether a statically generated guide can carry a runtime-dependent refusal. It does not have to be static. Packet page 1 is generated per packet and prints this packet's own values: on post-adjudication-boundary it reads 'Prepared for Alexandrina-Katharine Montgomery-Vandenberg-Oyelaran y Fitzwilliam III; case 0123-45-2026-CR-900123.00-AB-CDE/2201.' The delivered packet prints the case number in full on page 1 and leaves it blank in the caption on page 2. The surface that would carry the disclosure exists, is per-packet, already holds the value, and says nothing.
theARKANSASBLANKFIELDSQUESTION.whichObligationOwnsIt: KNOWN_PREFILLS. The obligation is that a fact the platform holds and the field map binds reaches the delivered page, in the right place and the right form, and that any deviation is disclosed. An undisclosed OMISSION is strictly larger than the undisclosed reformat that failed Maine's KNOWN_PREFILLS on this same return. It is not REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING: these are not record-declared required-before-filing items, they are known prefills the build could not fit, and the guide's 66-row list is not where they would belong.
theARKANSASBLANKFIELDSQUESTION.whyItMatters: On the boundary proposed order, packet page 8 carries 0 px of added ink where the canonical carries 474 and 488 - the clause asking the court to dismiss and seal names no one. A pleading with a blank case number in its caption and an unnamed petitioner in its prayer is not a filing defect a clerk quietly fixes. It is also invisible to every counter the factory has: addedInkRunsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes is 0, the appearance overflow count is 0, protectedWrites is 0, and requiredComponentsMissing is 0, all correctly. The only thing that sees it is comparing the boundary fixture to the canonical one, which is what boundary fixtures are for.
theARKANSASBLANKFIELDSQUESTION.whatWouldSatisfyIt: Print the refusals the build already composes. Each of the ten carries a documentId, a field, the printed row it belongs to, the usable width, and a finished participant-facing sentence. Emitting them onto the per-packet guidance page - the page that already names the participant and the case - would close it, would move no PDF byte on the canonical fixtures, and would need no shared-library change.

rasterPixelCounts.aFontMetricsTrapTHISLANEFELLINTOANDCLIMB: A first pass measured drawn-string widths with a uniform 500/1000 advance and reported 2 overflows on post-adjudication-boundary that are NOT on the page. Recorded because the error was in the direction that MANUFACTURES an overflow, and because the opposite error - the same fallback on Times-Roman - hides one.
